text: Post-operative week 5. Patient recovered well from surgery, wound healing appropriately. Ready to initiate adjuvant chemotherapy. Plan: FOLFOX (Oxaliplatin, 5-FU, Leucovorin) + Bevacizumab for 12 cycles (6 months). Baseline CEA: 12.3 ng/mL (decreased from preop 78.5). Port placement scheduled. Pre-chemo labs: CBC, CMP, Mg within normal limits. Patient counseled on expected side effects: neuropathy, diarrhea, fatigue, cold sensitivity. Will monitor CEA every 2 cycles. Surveillance CT scans every 3 months. Patient motivated and understands treatment plan. ECOG performance status 1.
